stem: How does Carol’s motivation to discover the truth affect the rising action of the excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: It develops the idea that Carol believes in facts.

options.label: B
options.text: It creates a conflict between Carol and her mother.

options.label: C
options.text: It reveals a connection between Carol and Mr. Linden.

options.label: D
options.text: It provides a reason for Carol to return to Mr. Linden’s library.
